note: Starter builds: small, finished, openable artifacts kept in the repository so a new visitor sees what Massai makes without spending a token. They are curated by the owner, never generated on request.

starters.name: Spend log
starters.what: What the month is doing, kept in the browser.

starters.name: Converter
starters.what: Length, mass and volume, with a picker that cannot mix kinds.

starters.name: Countdown
starters.what: Counts the days to a date you set, and keeps it.

starters.name: Invoice
starters.what: Line items, tax, a total, and a print view.

starters.name: Notes shaper
starters.what: Sorts raw notes into decided, to-do and open. No invented content.

starters.name: Packing list
starters.what: A trip list with categories, ticks that survive a reload.

starters.name: Recipe card
starters.what: A printable recipe: needs, steps, notes.

starters.name: Tip splitter
starters.what: Splits a bill unevenly between people and shows each share.
